name: Bologna, Italy
note: Measured with Sentinel-1 from frames 117A_04454_131312 and 095D_04589_131313, COMET LiCSAR interferograms, October 2021 to April 2024. Vertical motion is tied to GNSS station BOLG.
caveat: Tied to GNSS only at BOLG. At BLGN they agree within 0.2 mm per year. At MEDI the scene reads +2.2 mm per year where GNSS reads -2.9, the opposite sign, from cells 3.8 to 4.4 km away. East of 11.45E values are relative only.
